column3: NKJV renders “I have paid attention to” as “I will punish.”
Close to the Hebrew; “which is before Egypt” is rendered “which is east of Egypt.”
Close to the Hebrew; the obscure word rendered “the second” is translated “the fatlings.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV adds “greatly” to “I regret,” and renders “my words” as “My commandments.”
NKJV supplies “as” in both lines (“rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft”), and renders וּתְרָפִים (“household gods”) as “idolatry.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “Saul” as the one who seized the robe.
Close to the Hebrew; “he will give it” is rendered “has given it.”
